description: A repository with no history - the drop-in folder before its first commit - still has a defined ledger and a defined head: the trailing build entry alone, whose prev is the 64-zero genesis. It replaces ledger-0003 for 1.1, where the trailing entry's actor is the fixed string process:agsc and not process:agsc/<version> (AGSC-08-20a). Without this rule the published agsc-ledger-head would be undefined for every freshly adopted Bundle.
